headline: Executive order signed in 2011 that bars certain business dealings involving North Korea.
what_it_does: This order makes some types of transactions involving North Korea illegal for people and companies under U.S. law. The title does not say exactly which transactions are covered. It adds to existing U.S. rules that limit trade and business with North Korea.

who_it_affects.group: U.S. businesses and individuals who trade with or do business involving North Korea
who_it_affects.how: They are barred from taking part in the kinds of transactions the order prohibits.

who_it_affects.group: The North Korean government and companies
who_it_affects.how: They lose access to certain dealings with U.S. people and businesses.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 18, 2011; the exact effective date is not stated in the source material.
